name: MSA Type 1 (Cg/Cgk)
description: Measurement System Analysis Type 1 — Repeatability (Cg) and Bias (Cgk)
whenToUse: When the capability of a single gage should be checked: a standard or reference part is measured repeatedly, giving repeatability (Cg) and bias (Cgk) — not for measurement systems with several appraisers or parts, which the type 2, 4, 5 and 6 studies cover. Requires the measurements as a numeric column of a data collection.
errRefMissing: Reference value is missing or invalid.
errUslLeqLsl: USL must be greater than LSL.
statusNoSpread: No spread measured – check gage resolution
interpCgPass: Repeatability is sufficient — gage spread is small enough relative to tolerance.
interpCgkPass: Systematic deviation (bias) of the gage from the reference value is acceptable.
interpWarn: Conditionally capable — action recommended (calibration, check environment, etc.).
interpFail: Not capable — gage must not be used for inspection.

invariants.limitsOrder: The lower spec limit (LSL) must be less than the upper (USL)
